source.notes: ICSE 2026 board examination paper (code 'T26 511' printed on every page) from the official CISCE Archive Library bundle 'ICSE-2026-MAIN-1.zip' (session 'Main examination' taken from the bundle's 'ICSE 2026 MAIN' folder name). No official marking scheme is published with this paper; questions carry no official answer. Paper prints 'Maximum Marks: 80', 'Time allowed: Three hours' and 'Attempt all questions from Section A and any four questions from Section B.' Section A (40 marks) = Question 1 (fifteen 1-mark MCQ/assertion-reason items, [15] printed for the whole question) + Question 2 (4+4+4) + Question 3 (4+4+5). Section B = Questions 4-10, each 10 marks (3+3+4, except Question 7 = 5+5), candidate attempts any four; all are included, so the marks in this pack add up to 110 rather than 80. No 'OR' alternatives are printed, so choiceGroup is null throughout; each (i)/(ii)/(iii) sub-part is its own entry and its (a)/(b)/(c) items are kept together. IMPORTANT: the text layer of the bold equation-editor expressions is corrupt (math-italic glyphs doubled, 'sec/cos/cosec/sin' collapsed, stacked fractions and matrix brackets lose their layout); prose and most plain-font expressions extract cleanly. Every mathematical expression was transcribed from pages rendered with pdfplumber and checked visually (zoomed crops for 1(xiv) and 2(ii)); such items are MEDIUM and flagged. Fractions are written inline (a/b), powers as Unicode superscripts, matrices row by row as [[row 1], [row 2]], tables as '|'-separated rows. Items that depend on a diagram or graph for data are LOW. No cognitive-level tags are printed on this paper.
